You are an expert Roblox game developer and game designer.

Create a complete, professional Roblox game called "MonsterVerse."

GAME GENRE
- Open-world monster collecting adventure
- Exploration RPG
- Mobile and PC optimized
- Bright, colorful low-poly Roblox style
- Smooth performance (60 FPS target)
- Beginner-friendly progression
- Highly expandable for future updates

==================================================
CORE GAMEPLAY LOOP
==================================================

Spawn
↓

Explore the world

↓

Find wild monsters

↓

Catch monsters

↓

Gain coins and XP

↓

Upgrade equipment

↓

Unlock new areas

↓

Discover rarer monsters

↓

Complete monster collection

↓

Become the strongest trainer

==================================================
WORLD 1
==================================================

Create a beautiful forest world approximately 250x250 studs.

Include:

• Spawn Village
• Shop
• Quest NPC
• Monster Research Lab
• Slime Meadow
• Dense Forest
• Flower Field
• River
• Pond
• Waterfall
• Wooden Bridge
• Cave Entrance
• Ancient Tree
• Small Hills
• Dirt Paths
• Cliffs around map edges

The map should feel alive and encourage exploration.

Premium Roblox quality

All AI should use reusable state machines.

Each monster stores:

Name

Description

Health

Speed

Run Speed

Level

XP Reward

Coin Reward

Catch Chance

Respawn Time

Rarity

Biome

Favorite Weather

Favorite Time

==================================================

==================================================

Common

Uncommon

Rare

Epic

Legendary

Mythic

Secret

Celestial

==================================================

Play sound

==================================================
INVENTORY
==================================================

Grid inventory

Monster cards

Search bar

Sorting

Filters

View stats

==================================================
SHOP
==================================================

Sell monsters

Capture capsules

Speed upgrades

Cosmetics

Bundles

Daily deals

==================================================
QUESTS
==================================================

Daily

Weekly

Story

Side quests

Rewards

Progress bars

Quest tracking

==================================================
ACHIEVEMENTS
==================================================

Catch monsters

Earn coins

Reach levels

Unlock worlds

Find secrets

Complete collection

==================================================
SAVE SYSTEM
==================================================

Use DataStoreService.

Save:

Coins

XP

Level

Inventory

Monster collection

Achievements

Quest progress

Settings

==================================================
USER INTERFACE
==================================================

Gems

XP Bar

Inventory

Monsters

Shop

Quests

Map

Settings

Buttons should have:

==================================================
AUDIO
==================================================

Forest ambience

Birds

Wind

Monster sounds

Button clicks

Coins

Quest complete

Level up

==================================================
PERFORMANCE
==================================================

StreamingEnabled

LOD friendly

Efficient AI

Low memory usage

==================================================
CODE QUALITY
==================================================

Use ModuleScripts.

Separate client and server logic.

Use RemoteEvents and RemoteFunctions securely.

Write clean, well-commented, modular Lua code.

Organize folders professionally.

Avoid duplicated code.

==================================================
FUTURE EXPANSION
==================================================

Design every system to support:

100+ monsters

20+ worlds

Trading

Evolution

Bosses

Guilds

Raids

PvP

Seasonal events

Weather system

Day/night cycle

Crafting

Mounts

Pets

==================================================
FINAL GOAL
==================================================

Build a polished, expandable Roblox game that feels like a premium monster-collecting adventure with smooth gameplay, professional UI, reusable systems, optimized performance, and a strong foundation for long-term updates.

answers.ask: Are the Shop, Monster Research Lab and Cave actually entered, or interacted with from outside? Interiors change the build route.
answers.answer: Use simple enterable interiors for the Shop and Monster Research Lab, and make the Cave a short accessible cave area entered through its entrance.

scene_prompt: Create a bright, colorful low-poly open-world monster-collecting adventure map, World 1, approximately 250x250 studs. Build a Spawn Village as the central hub, with a simple enterable Shop and Monster Research Lab, plus a Quest NPC area. Dirt paths lead outward through a Slime Meadow, dense forest, and flower field, connecting small hills, an ancient tree landmark, a river with a wooden bridge, a pond, and a waterfall. Place a cave entrance leading into a short accessible cave area. Enclose the outer edges with cliffs, with the major biomes and landmarks distributed to encourage exploration. Use rounded stylized terrain, bright foliage, soft atmospheric lighting, and subtle animated grass, wind, and environmental particle effects.
blob:
### 1. Genre
The dominant genre is `RPG`: progression, monster collection, XP, equipment upgrades, and increasingly rare creatures define the game. Adventure is secondary through exploration, but RPG owns the world shape.

### 2. Shape and preset
Use `world-open`, a single contiguous 250×250-stud forest world where the village, creature habitats, and landmarks coexist and can be explored in flexible order. The closest preset is Turn-based RPG, retaining its sanctuary-town and wild-creature placement logic while dropping `gate-progression`, since no physical level locks are requested.

### 3. Config requirements
Use `safezone-town` for the central Spawn Village, isolated from wild-monster habitat and containing restock and quest functions. Use `social-hub` as a compact shop, lab, and quest-giver cluster at its center. Use `building-interior` for the enterable Shop, Monster Research Lab, and short cave area. Use `npc-population` for the Quest NPC and the five starter monster species inhabiting their outdoor biomes. Use `water-body` for the river, pond, and waterfall. Use `terrain-relief` for rounded small hills and perimeter cliffs. Use `landmark-focal` for the ancient tree, visible as an exploration anchor.

### 4. Layout requirements
Place `spawner-npc` points in sheltered, readable habitat pockets: Green and Blue Slimes in Slime Meadow near the riverbank, Bees in the flower field, Bunnies along meadow and forest edges, and Foxes deeper in dense forest. Use several distributed points per biome rather than placing creatures on the main paths. Place `npc-population` as one Quest NPC in the village quest area, with ambient creature ground reserved around each habitat. No other placed gameplay volumes are required.

### 5. Layout components
The Spawn Village occupies the central clearing, roughly one quarter of the map width, with the Shop and Research Lab facing a small quest plaza. Dirt paths radiate from it: west into Slime Meadow, east through the flower field, and north into dense forest. Put the ancient tree in the deeper northern forest as the distant focal landmark. Run a river across one side of the world, widening into a pond and dropping as a waterfall near a cliff; a wooden bridge carries the main path over it. Put the cave entrance in a perimeter cliff and connect it to a short accessible interior cave. Scatter low rounded hills between biomes. Cliff walls fully enclose the outer map edge while foliage thickens at biome boundaries. Compose the frame from above with the village central, paths visibly branching, and the ancient tree and waterfall as opposing landmarks.

### 6. Render order
Use `topdown` first and treat it as authoritative, because all habitats, paths, river crossings, and outside-to-inside entrances must remain coherently connected for exploration.

### 7. Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium, driven by the approximately 250×250-stud single world with several distinct biomes. Theme: bright colorful low-poly Roblox forest, rounded stylized terrain, soft atmospheric light, lively foliage and subtle environmental effects. Pipeline modifiers are `tiered` for the hills and cliffs without overhangs, and `P3` because players cross from the exterior village into the Shop, Research Lab, and cave interiors.
